en: Colorized historic postcard showing the massive round White Tower (Turnul Alb) of Brașov with crenellated walls and a small red‑roofed annex. In the foreground, people in early‑20th‑century clothing stroll and sit on benches along a tree‑lined promenade; in the background appears part of the town and surrounding hills. The front caption names Brașov and the tower in multiple languages (Romanian, Hungarian, German). The reverse bears the bilingual heading for postcard/cardă poștală in Romanian and Hungarian.
